cards.question: Что такое Go (Golang)?
cards.reference: Компилируемый статически типизированный язык от Google: простой синтаксис, сборщик мусора, встроенная конкурентность через goroutines.

cards.question: Как объявить package?
cards.reference: Первая строка файла: package main для исполняемого, package foo для библиотеки. Имя пакета совпадает с каталогом модуля (обычно).

cards.question: Точка входа main?
cards.reference: func main() в пакете main — единственная точка входа программы.

cards.question: Как импортировать пакеты?
cards.reference: import "fmt" или блок import ( ... ). Неиспользуемый импорт — ошибка компиляции.

cards.question: Короткое объявление переменной :=
cards.reference: x := 10 — тип выводится компилятором. Только внутри функций.

cards.question: var vs :=
cards.reference: var x int = 10 — явный тип; var x = 10 — вывод типа; := — короткая форма в функции.

cards.question: Нулевые значения (zero values)?
cards.reference: int→0, string→"", bool→false, pointer/slice/map/channel/func/interface→nil.

cards.question: Константы const?
cards.reference: const Pi = 3.14; const (A=1; B=2). Без явного типа — untyped constant.

cards.question: Что такое iota?
cards.reference: Генератор последовательных untyped int констант в блоке const: const (A=iota; B; C) → 0,1,2.

cards.question: if с коротким объявлением?
cards.reference: if err := f(); err != nil { ... } — переменная в scope только if/else.

cards.question: for — единственный цикл?
cards.reference: Да: for {}, for i:=0; i<n; i++, for range. while через for condition.

cards.question: switch в Go?
cards.reference: Автоматический break; case может быть несколько значений; switch без выражения — как if-else chain.

cards.question: switch с типом (type switch)?
cards.reference: switch v := x.(type) { case int: ... } для проверки динамического типа interface{}.

cards.question: Что такое fallthrough?
cards.reference: Явный переход к следующему case в switch (редко, обычно не нужен).

cards.question: Что такое goto?
cards.reference: Есть, но не рекомендуется; используется в generated code и редких low-level случаях.

cards.question: Порядок инициализации?
cards.reference: Пакеты: init() всех imported пакетов → init() текущего → main().

cards.question: В чём разница между fmt.Println и Print?
cards.reference: Println добавляет пробелы между аргументами и перевод строки.

cards.question: fmt.Printf и verb %v?
cards.reference: %v — default format; %+v struct с полями; %#v Go-syntax; %T тип.

cards.question: Строки в Go?
cards.reference: Immutable byte sequence (UTF-8). string ↔ []byte через []byte(s) и string(b).

cards.question: Что такое rune?
cards.reference: Alias для int32 — кодовая точка Unicode. range по string даёт rune и index.

cards.question: Что такое byte?
cards.reference: Alias для uint8.

cards.question: Арифметика int?
cards.reference: int размер зависит от платформы (32/64 bit). Явно int32/int64 для переносимости.

cards.question: Приведение типов?
cards.reference: T(v) — явное; между числовыми типами только явно; нет implicit numeric promotion как в C.

cards.question: Сравнение struct?
cards.reference: Можно если все поля comparable. Slice/map/func нельзя сравнивать через ==.

cards.question: Короткое объявление := и shadowing?
cards.reference: := создаёт новую переменную если хотя бы одно имя новое в блоке; иначе присваивание.

cards.question: Поясните: Blank identifier _.
cards.reference: Игнорирует значение: _, err := f(). Импорт _ для side-effect init.

cards.question: Поясните: go fmt (gofmt).
cards.reference: Стандартный форматтер — обязательная практика; go fmt ./...

cards.question: Поясните: go vet.
cards.reference: Статический анализ подозрительных конструкций.

cards.question: Комментарии // и /* */?
cards.reference: Стандартные; godoc парсит комментарии перед exported symbols.

cards.question: В чём разница между Exported и unexported?
cards.reference: Имя с большой буквы — exported (public), с маленькой — package-private.

cards.question: В чём разница между array и slice?
cards.reference: Array [N]T — фиксированный размер, value type. Slice []T — descriptor (ptr,len,cap), reference view.

cards.question: Как создать slice?
cards.reference: []int{}, make([]int, len), make([]int, len, cap), slice literal, arr[:] из array.

cards.question: Что такое append?
cards.reference: append(s, x) может реалллоцировать; нужно s = append(s, x). Variadic: append(s, others...).

cards.question: В чём разница между len и cap slice?
cards.reference: len — длина элементов; cap — ёмкость underlying array от offset.

cards.question: Поясните: slice s[low:high].
cards.reference: Half-open [low, high). Max high = cap(s). s[:0] — zero len, сохраняет cap.

cards.question: Что такое copy?
cards.reference: copy(dst, src) — копирует min(len(dst), len(src)) элементов, возвращает count.

cards.question: Что такое map?
cards.reference: make(map[K]V). Запись m[k]=v. Чтение v, ok := m[k]. delete(m,k). Nil map нельзя писать.

cards.question: Что такое struct?
cards.reference: type User struct { ID int; Name string }. Literal User{ID:1, Name:"a"} или positional.

cards.question: Embedded struct (composition)?
cards.reference: type Admin struct { User; Role string } — promotion полей User.

cards.question: Указатели *T?
cards.reference: &x — адрес, *p — dereference. new(T) — allocate zero value, возвращает *T.

cards.question: В чём разница между new и make?
cards.reference: new(T) — *T zero value. make — только slice, map, channel; возвращает initialized value (not pointer).

cards.question: Pointer receiver и nil?
cards.reference: Метод с pointer receiver можно вызвать на nil pointer (если метод проверяет nil).

cards.question: Поясните: Comparable types.
cards.reference: Можно использовать как map key: numbers, string, pointer, array (if elements comparable), struct (if fields comparable).

cards.question: Slice как map value?
cards.reference: Да, но изменение slice in-place видно всем, кто держит тот же backing array.

cards.question: Что такое strings.Builder?
cards.reference: Эффективная конкатенация строк без лишних аллокаций.

cards.question: Поясните: strings.Split / Join.
cards.reference: Split(s, sep) → []string; strings.Join(parts, sep).

cards.question: Поясните: strconv.Itoa / Atoi.
cards.reference: Конвертация int ↔ string. ParseInt, FormatInt для base/size.

cards.question: byte slice и string sharing?
cards.reference: []byte(s) копирует; unsafe conversion возможна но не recommended без care.

cards.question: Поясните: struct tags.
cards.reference: `json:"name,omitempty"` — metadata для encoding/json через reflection.

cards.question: Поясните: JSON marshal struct.
cards.reference: encoding/json Marshal/Unmarshal. Exported fields only. json tag controls names.

cards.question: Type alias vs type definition?
cards.reference: type Alias = T — alias. type New T — новый distinct type с тем же underlying.

cards.question: runes in string length?
cards.reference: len(string) — bytes, not runes. utf8.RuneCountInString(s).

cards.question: Поясните: Clear slice.
cards.reference: s = s[:0] сохраняет cap; s = nil — discard. clear(s) Go 1.21+ для maps/slices.

cards.question: Поясните: maps iteration order.
cards.reference: Randomized — не полагаться на порядок.

cards.question: Поясните: struct padding.
cards.reference: Компилятор выравнивает поля; порядок полей влияет на размер struct.

cards.question: Поясните: Empty struct struct{}.
cards.reference: Zero-size; используется как set member или signal в channel.

cards.question: Slice tricks delete element?
cards.reference: s = append(s[:i], s[i+1:]...) — O(n); для частых delete лучше другая структура.

cards.question: Поясните: 2D slice.
cards.reference: [][]int — slice of slices; rows могут иметь разную длину (jagged).

cards.question: Heap vs stack в Go?
cards.reference: Escape analysis решает; compiler may allocate on heap if escapes.

cards.question: Объявление func?
cards.reference: func name(params) returnType { }. Multiple returns: (int, error). Named returns allowed.

cards.question: Поясните: Multiple return values.
cards.reference: Идиоматично (result, err). Caller: v, err := f().

cards.question: Поясните: Variadic functions.
cards.reference: func sum(nums ...int) — nums is []int inside. Call: sum(1,2,3).

cards.question: Что такое defer?
cards.reference: Откладывает вызов до return функции; аргументы вычисляются сразу при defer statement.

cards.question: Порядок defer?
cards.reference: LIFO — последний defer выполняется первым.

cards.question: defer и return?
cards.reference: Deferred func видит named return values после их установки; может modify named returns.

cards.question: defer для close?
cards.reference: defer f.Close() — стандарт для files, bodies, rows.

cards.question: Поясните: defer recover.
cards.reference: recover() только внутри deferred func — ловит panic.

cards.question: Что такое panic?
cards.reference: Немедленная остановка goroutine; unwinds stack running defers; если не recovered — crash program.

cards.question: Что такое recover?
cards.reference: Возвращает value passed to panic; nil если нет panic.

cards.question: Когда panic vs error?
cards.reference: error для expected failures; panic для programmer bugs / unrecoverable invariants.

cards.question: Поясните: Function as value.
cards.reference: Functions are first-class: var fn func(int) int = square.

cards.question: Что такое Closures?
cards.reference: Anonymous func захватывает переменные из enclosing scope by reference.

cards.question: Loop variable in closure trap?
cards.reference: Go 1.22+ per-iteration vars; до 1.21 копируй i := i в loop body перед goroutine/closure.

cards.question: Поясните: init function.
cards.reference: func init() — автоматический вызов при load пакета; нельзя вызвать явно.

cards.question: main без args?
cards.reference: os.Args через import "os" — не параметры main как в C.

cards.question: Поясните: Recursive functions.
cards.reference: Allowed; watch stack overflow on deep recursion — prefer iteration or trampoline.

cards.question: Поясните: Method value.
cards.reference: f := obj.Method — bound method value; later f(args) without receiver.

cards.question: Поясните: Method expression.
cards.reference: f := Type.Method — needs receiver as first arg: f(obj, args).

cards.question: Поясните: Blank return.
cards.reference: return без значений при named returns — returns current named vars.

cards.question: Поясните: Function type alias.
cards.reference: type Handler func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request)

cards.question: Что такое Inlining?
cards.reference: Compiler inlines small functions; не полагаться для side effects order across packages.

cards.question: Поясните: go:noinline directive.
cards.reference: //go:noinline — для benchmarking/debug (advanced).

cards.question: Поясните: defer performance.
cards.reference: Small overhead; в hot paths иногда explicit close, обычно defer ok.

cards.question: Поясните: Higher-order functions.
cards.reference: Передача func как параметр: sort.Slice, http.HandlerFunc.

cards.question: Поясните: IIFE in Go.
cards.reference: func(){ ... }() — immediately invoked func literal.

cards.question: Поясните: Return early pattern.
cards.reference: if err != nil { return ..., err } — guard clauses, flat code.

cards.question: Поясните: Function documentation.
cards.reference: Comment before func starting with func name — godoc.

cards.question: Поясните: Method syntax.
cards.reference: func (r Receiver) Name(args) return { } — receiver like parameter.

cards.question: В чём разница между Pointer и value receiver?
cards.reference: Pointer — mutate state, avoid copy large struct, consistency. Value — small immutable types.

cards.question: Что такое Interface?
cards.reference: type Reader interface { Read(p []byte) (n int, err error) } — implicit satisfaction.

cards.question: Поясните: Implicit interfaces.
cards.reference: No implements keyword — type satisfies interface if has all methods.

cards.question: Поясните: Empty interface any.
cards.reference: interface{} / any — любой тип. Использовать sparingly; prefer generics/concrete types.

cards.question: Поясните: Type assertion.
cards.reference: v := x.(T) panic if fail; v, ok := x.(T) safe.

cards.question: Поясните: Type switch.
cards.reference: switch t := x.(type) { case int: ... default: ... }

cards.question: Поясните: Interface nil gotcha.
cards.reference: Interface nil only if type AND value nil. var p *T=nil; var i interface{}=p → i!=nil (typed nil).

cards.question: Поясните: io.Reader / io.Writer.
cards.reference: Core abstractions для streaming I/O; compose через wrappers.

cards.question: Что такое fmt.Stringer?
cards.reference: String() string — fmt prints it automatically.

cards.question: Поясните: error interface.
cards.reference: type error interface { Error() string } — universal error type.

cards.question: Comparable interface constraints?
cards.reference: Go 1.18+ constraints for generics: comparable for ==.

cards.question: Поясните: Embedding interface.
cards.reference: type ReadWriter interface { Reader; Writer } — embed other interfaces.

cards.question: Method set pointer receiver?
cards.reference: T satisfies interface with pointer methods only if *T used (or T addressable).

cards.question: Interface value representation?
cards.reference: (type, data) pair — dynamic type + value pointer.

cards.question: Поясните: Polymorphism in Go.
cards.reference: Through interfaces, not inheritance.

cards.question: Composition over inheritance?
cards.reference: Embed structs/interfaces instead of class hierarchies.

cards.question: Поясните: Small interfaces.
cards.reference: Idiom: io.Reader one method — easier mocks and reuse (accept interfaces, return structs).

cards.question: Поясните: Adapter pattern.
cards.reference: type Logger interface; wrap third-party type with methods matching interface.

cards.question: Поясните: Mocking via interface.
cards.reference: Define interface at consumer; test inject fake implementation.

cards.question: Поясните: errors.As / errors.Is.
cards.reference: Unwrap error chains; check wrapped types and sentinel values.

cards.question: Что такое io.Closer?
cards.reference: Close() error — defer close pattern.

cards.question: Что такое sort.Interface?
cards.reference: Len, Less, Swap — legacy; prefer sort.Slice.

cards.question: Что такое http.Handler?
cards.reference: ServeHTTP(ResponseWriter, *Request) — net/http core interface.

cards.question: Поясните: Context interface.
cards.reference: context.Context — Done, Err, Deadline, Value for cancellation/timeouts.

cards.question: Unexported interface in package?
cards.reference: Private interface for internal abstraction — can't be satisfied from outside accidentally.

cards.question: Generics with interface constraint?
cards.reference: type Stringer interface { String() string }; func F[T Stringer](v T)

cards.question: Satisfying interface compile-time check?
cards.reference: var _ MyInterface = (*MyType)(nil) — assert *MyType implements MyInterface.

cards.question: Method on non-local type?
cards.reference: Cannot add methods to types from other packages — wrap type locally.

cards.question: Что такое Goroutine?
cards.reference: go f() — lightweight thread, multiplexed on OS threads by runtime.

cards.question: Что такое GOMAXPROCS?
cards.reference: Controls OS threads for Go code execution; default NumCPU.

cards.question: Что такое Channel?
cards.reference: make(chan T), make(chan T, buf). Send ch<-v, receive <-ch. Close closes channel.

cards.question: Поясните: Unbuffered channel.
cards.reference: Synchronizes — send blocks until receive ready (handoff).

cards.question: Поясните: Buffered channel.
cards.reference: Send blocks when buffer full; receive when empty.

cards.question: Поясните: close channel.
cards.reference: close(ch) — receivers get zero value + ok=false. Sender closes, not receiver.

cards.question: Поясните: Range over channel.
cards.reference: for v := range ch { } until closed and drained.

cards.question: Что такое select?
cards.reference: select { case v:=<-ch1: case ch2<-x: default: } — multiplex; default non-blocking.

cards.question: Поясните: select with timeout.
cards.reference: case <-time.After(d): ... or context cancellation.

cards.question: Поясните: Worker pool pattern.
cards.reference: Fixed N goroutines reading jobs from channel.

cards.question: Поясните: Fan-in / fan-out.
cards.reference: Merge multiple channels into one / distribute work from one to many.

cards.question: Поясните: Done channel pattern.
cards.reference: close(done) broadcast shutdown to workers.

cards.question: context.Context cancellation?
cards.reference: ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent); defer cancel(); <-ctx.Done().

cards.question: Что такое WaitGroup?
cards.reference: wg.Add(n); go func(){ defer wg.Done(); ...}(); wg.Wait().

cards.question: Поясните: Mutex sync.Mutex.
cards.reference: Lock/Unlock protect shared memory; defer mu.Unlock().

cards.question: Что такое RWMutex?
cards.reference: RLock for reads, Lock for writes.

cards.question: Что такое sync.Once?
cards.reference: once.Do(func()) — exactly once initialization (thread-safe).

cards.question: Поясните: atomic package.
cards.reference: atomic.AddInt64 etc. — lock-free primitives for simple counters/flags.

cards.question: Поясните: Race detector.
cards.reference: go run -race — detects data races at runtime (testing/dev).

cards.question: Поясните: Goroutine leak.
cards.reference: Blocked forever on send/receive — use context, buffer, or ensure consumer.

cards.question: Поясните: Pipeline pattern.
cards.reference: Stages connected by channels — each stage goroutine.

cards.question: Buffered vs unbuffered tradeoff?
cards.reference: Buffer decouples timing but hides backpressure; choose consciously.

cards.question: Поясните: nil channel behavior.
cards.reference: Send/receive on nil channel block forever — sometimes used in select tricks.

cards.question: Поясните: Directional channel types.
cards.reference: chan<- T send-only, <-chan T receive-only in function signatures.

cards.question: Поясните: time.Ticker / Timer.
cards.reference: Ticker periodic; Timer one-shot; stop to release resources.

cards.question: Что такое sync.Map?
cards.reference: Concurrent map optimized for read-heavy caches; not default choice vs mutex+map.

cards.question: Что такое errgroup?
cards.reference: golang.org/x/sync/errgroup — goroutine group with first error cancel.

cards.question: Semaphore via buffered channel?
cards.reference: sem := make(chan struct{}, N); acquire sem<-struct{}{}; release <-sem.

cards.question: Don't communicate by sharing memory?
cards.reference: Go proverb — prefer channels; but mutex ok for simple shared state.

cards.question: error — built-in interface?
cards.reference: Error() string — return errors, don't throw (except panic for bugs).

cards.question: if err != nil?
cards.reference: Universal idiom after calls returning error.

cards.question: Что такое fmt.Errorf?
cards.reference: Create error; %w wraps: fmt.Errorf("context: %w", err) for unwrap chain.

cards.question: Что такое errors.New?
cards.reference: Simple static error: errors.New("not found").

cards.question: Поясните: Sentinel errors.
cards.reference: var ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found") — compare with errors.Is.

cards.question: Что такое errors.Is?
cards.reference: errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) — works through wrapped errors.

cards.question: Что такое errors.As?
cards.reference: errors.As(err, &target) — find typed error in chain.

cards.question: Что такое errors.Unwrap?
cards.reference: Returns wrapped error from fmt.Errorf %w or custom Unwrap().

cards.question: Поясните: Custom error type.
cards.reference: type MyError struct { Code int }; func (e *MyError) Error() string

cards.question: Return error as last value?
cards.reference: Convention: (T, error) or just error.

cards.question: В чём разница между panic и error in library?
cards.reference: Library returns error; panic only for impossible internal state.

cards.question: Что такое log.Fatal?
cards.reference: Log and os.Exit(1) — not defer-friendly; avoid in libraries.

cards.question: Что такое Multierror?
cards.reference: errors.Join (Go 1.20+) combines multiple errors.

cards.question: errors.Is vs ==
cards.reference: Use Is for sentinel; == breaks with wrapping.

cards.question: Поясните: Handling HTTP errors.
cards.reference: Check status code; decode body; wrap with context.

cards.question: Что такое io.EOF?
cards.reference: Not failure — end of stream; handle separately from real errors.

cards.question: Context.Canceled / DeadlineExceeded?
cards.reference: Standard context errors from ctx.Err().

cards.question: Error string capitalization?
cards.reference: No trailing period; lowercase start unless proper noun (Go style guide).

cards.question: Поясните: Don't ignore errors.
cards.reference: _ = f() discouraged; handle or explicitly document why ignored.

cards.question: Поясните: errors in init.
cards.reference: init can panic on misconfiguration; libraries prefer returning error from constructor.

cards.question: Поясните: Must functions.
cards.reference: template.Must, regexp.MustCompile — panic on compile error at init.

cards.question: Compare wrapped error messages?
cards.reference: Avoid; use Is/As on sentinel/types.

cards.question: Поясните: errors.Join use case.
cards.reference: Aggregate validation failures from multiple fields.

cards.question: Temporary / timeout errors?
cards.reference: net.Error Timeout(); os.IsTimeout(err) helpers.

cards.question: Error handling in defer?
cards.reference: Named return err; defer func(){ if e!=nil { err=...}}()

cards.question: Поясните: os.Open / ReadFile.
cards.reference: os.Open for streaming; os.ReadFile reads all bytes (Go 1.16+).

cards.question: Что такое io.Copy?
cards.reference: Stream copy between Reader and Writer efficiently.

cards.question: Что такое bufio.Scanner?
cards.reference: Line/token scanning; Scan loop; Err() after false Scan.

cards.question: Что такое path/filepath?
cards.reference: Join, Clean, Base — OS-aware paths (not path for URLs).

cards.question: Что такое encoding/json?
cards.reference: Marshal, Unmarshal, NewEncoder(w).Encode(v).

cards.question: Поясните: net/http server.
cards.reference: http.HandleFunc, http.ListenAndServe. Handler interface.

cards.question: Что такое http.Client?
cards.reference: client.Get(url); customize Timeout, Transport.

cards.question: Поясните: context in HTTP.
cards.reference: r.Context(); pass to downstream; server shutdown with Server.Shutdown.

cards.question: Поясните: time package.
cards.reference: time.Now(), Parse, Format layout reference Mon Jan 2 15:04:05 MST 2006.

cards.question: Что такое time.Duration?
cards.reference: time.Second, time.Millisecond; d := 5 * time.Second.

cards.question: Что такое sort.Slice?
cards.reference: sort.Slice(items, func(i,j int) bool { return items[i]<items[j] })

cards.question: slices package Go 1.21+?
cards.reference: slices.Sort, Contains, Clone — generic slice helpers.

cards.question: maps package Go 1.21+?
cards.reference: maps.Clone, maps.Keys, maps.Values.

cards.question: Что такое bytes.Buffer?
cards.reference: In-memory buffer implementing Writer/Reader for building bytes.

cards.question: Что такое regexp?
cards.reference: Compile pattern; MatchString; FindStringSubmatch.

cards.question: Поясните: flag package.
cards.reference: CLI flags for simple tools; flag.Parse().

cards.question: Поясните: log package.
cards.reference: log.Println; log.SetFlags; structured logging often via slog (Go 1.21+).

cards.question: Что такое log/slog?
cards.reference: Structured leveled logging: slog.Info("msg", "key", value).

cards.question: Поясните: embed package.
cards.reference: //go:embed files — compile-time embed FS in binary.

cards.question: Что такое crypto/sha256?
cards.reference: Hash data: sha256.Sum256(b) or New()+Write.

cards.question: Что такое database/sql?
cards.reference: sql.Open, db.Query, db.Exec, rows.Scan — generic SQL API.

cards.question: html/template vs text/template?
cards.reference: html/template auto-escapes — use for HTML output.

cards.question: Поясните: os.Getenv / LookupEnv.
cards.reference: Environment variables; prefer explicit config injection in apps.

cards.question: Поясните: io/ioutil deprecated.
cards.reference: Functions moved to io and os packages in Go 1.16.

cards.question: Что такое net/url?
cards.reference: Parse URLs; Query encoding/decoding.

cards.question: Что такое strconv.ParseBool?
